data.gender_notes: Puranmal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Puran means ancient and mal means wise or old. This name signifies an elderly, wise person who carries the knowledge and history of the past. The name Puranmal carries the meaning “Ancient, Wise, Old” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Puranmal usually hope their child will grow to embody ancient, wise, old and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who carry the wisdom of the ancient past and serve as a guide for future generations.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Puranmal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Puranmal is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and history, emphasizing the reverence for elders and their accumulated wisdom. In Hindu mythology, elders hold a distinguished position and their advice is highly valued. The name Puranmal signifies an individual who embodies the value of wisdom through age and experience, underscoring the importance of respecting and learning from elders.

The name Puranmal calls upon the individual to honor their inner sage, to seek knowledge and wisdom, and to share their accumulated insight and experience with others.

historical_references.reference: Puranmal was a Jain merchant from Gujarat who played a significant role in the establishment of the Jain pilgrimage site at Mount Abu in the 11th century.
historical_references.context: During the medieval period, Gujarat was a major center for Jainism and trade. Puranmal's contributions led to the development of Mount Abu as an important religious site for Jains.

historical_references.reference: Puranmal was also known as Puranmal Suri and was a prominent Jain scholar, poet, and philosopher in the 14th century. He composed several works on Jain philosophy and contributed to the development of the Digambara sect.
historical_references.context: The Digambara sect of Jainism emphasizes the importance of nudity and renunciation as a means to attain spiritual liberation. Puranmal's writings helped to establish and further develop this sect within Indian society.
